acquisition_epoch: 2001 multiday composite, released 2002; not simulated epoch or live weather
transform: Native-pixel crops; eight real neighboring-pixel gutters on all edges, longitude wraps and latitude clamps. Grayscale WebP quality90/method4, no resize, sharpening, inpainting or procedural detail. Pillow 11.2.1.

compression_validation.scale: 8-bit channel units, compared to original native L pixels before runtime decode

limits: Static visual coverage artwork only; not cloud-water, historical weather, RF attenuation or thermal-environment truth.
Source composite artifacts, including a western-US mosaic wedge, are preserved.
Native nominal1km is coarser than the500m regional land imagery.
Nine tile resident limit, two concurrent loads, single-channel R8 textures; GPU mips at most48MiB and retained CPU mask data at most36MiB.
Only camera-neighborhood coverage is resident; matched area-reduced NASA global coverage remains beyond loaded tiles and near some horizon/polar edges.
